title: World map interactions, country aliases, and smarter geography questions
body:
WORLD MAP PERFORMANCE & INTERACTION
- Restored native SVG paths for world-map countries, bringing back country clicks, hover highlights, and tooltips.
- Optimized world and continental GeoJSON datasets, reducing map payload by approximately 65%.
- Refined map framing, matched the background to Esri ocean color (#232227), and stopped unwanted horizontal wrapping.

SMARTER QUESTION ANSWERING
- Repeated local fact questions reuse compiled query plans, avoiding redundant parsing.
- Questions about founders, original signatories, and accession dates (including EU founding members / Inner Six) now use historical knowledge instead of current membership.

COUNTRY NAMES & ACRONYMS
- Added Polish and English aliases for 196 countries, including Micronesia (Federated States of Micronesia) and Czechia (Czech Republic).
- Standard country acronyms with or without periods (including U.S., USA, U.K., and UK) are recognized consistently.

CONTINENTAL CHALLENGES & QUESTION CHAT
- Answer reports now work on Europedle and other continental challenges and reference the correct game.
- Made the in-game question chat more compact.
